value.rule_description: Check for presence of invoice number
value.validation_logic: Verify that the invoice number field is not empty or null

value.rule_description: Check for presence of invoice date
value.validation_logic: Verify that the invoice date field is not empty or null and is in a valid date format

value.rule_description: Check for presence of vendor information
value.validation_logic: Verify that the vendor name or ID field is not empty or null

value.rule_description: Check for presence of GSTIN
value.validation_logic: Verify that the GSTIN field is not empty or null and matches standard GSTIN format

value.rule_description: Check for presence of PO reference
value.validation_logic: Verify that the PO number or reference field is not empty or null

value.rule_description: Check for presence of item details
value.validation_logic: Verify that at least one line item is present with description, quantity, and price

value.rule_description: Verify vendor consistency against master data
value.validation_logic: Compare invoice vendor name or ID with master vendor database for exact match

value.rule_description: Verify GSTIN consistency against vendor master
value.validation_logic: Compare invoice GSTIN with the GSTIN associated with the vendor in master data

value.rule_description: Check for existence of referenced PO
value.validation_logic: Query PO database to confirm the referenced PO number exists and is active

value.rule_description: Check PO-vendor linkage
value.validation_logic: Verify that the vendor on the invoice matches the vendor on the referenced PO

value.rule_description: Check currency consistency with PO
value.validation_logic: Compare invoice currency code with the currency code on the referenced PO

value.rule_description: Check invoice date chronology against PO date
value.validation_logic: Ensure invoice date is on or after the PO creation or effective date

value.rule_description: Check invoice date chronology against GRN date
value.validation_logic: Ensure invoice date is on or after the latest GRN date for the referenced items

value.rule_description: Verify line-level arithmetic consistency
value.validation_logic: For each line item, confirm that quantity multiplied by unit price equals the line total, accounting for any discounts or taxes

value.rule_description: Verify total-level arithmetic consistency
value.validation_logic: Confirm that the sum of all line totals plus applicable taxes and fees equals the invoice grand total

value.rule_description: Check invoice amount against PO tolerance
value.validation_logic: Ensure invoice total is within predefined percentage or absolute tolerance of the PO total amount

value.rule_description: Check cumulative PO usage
value.validation_logic: Calculate sum of all prior invoices against the PO and ensure adding current invoice does not exceed PO total amount plus tolerance

value.rule_description: Verify PO line mapping
value.validation_logic: Ensure each invoice line item maps to a corresponding line in the PO by item code or description

value.rule_description: Check price tolerance against PO
value.validation_logic: For each mapped line, ensure invoice unit price is within predefined tolerance of PO unit price

value.rule_description: Check quantity tolerance against PO
value.validation_logic: For each mapped line, ensure invoice quantity is within predefined tolerance of remaining PO quantity

value.rule_description: Check for existence of referenced GRN
value.validation_logic: Query GRN database to confirm the referenced GRN number exists and is associated with the PO

value.rule_description: Check quantity tolerance against GRN
value.validation_logic: For each line, ensure invoice quantity does not exceed GRN received quantity plus predefined tolerance

value.rule_description: Perform three-way match outcome check
value.validation_logic: Confirm that invoice quantities, prices, and totals match within tolerances to both PO and GRN documents

value.rule_description: Check for required stamps or seals
value.validation_logic: Verify presence of required digital or physical stamps as per compliance standards

value.rule_description: Check for compliance requirements
value.validation_logic: Ensure invoice meets all regulatory compliance fields, such as tax declarations or certifications
